content.title: BOGO (buy one, get one)
content.text: Your Privacy PreferencesIf you would like to submit a Data Subject Request, please click here: Data Subject Request FormWe use cookies to enhance your website and app experience, improve functionality and support our marketing efforts. You can manage your cookie preferences by clicking “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information / Opt Out.” If you wish to opt out of Chipotle’s sharing your personal information directly with third parties for the purpose of targeted advertising, please click on “Your Privacy Choices” link in the footer of our website and complete the US Consumer Data Request Form found under the Data Subject Rights tab. To learn more, please review our Cookie Policy and our visit our recently updated Privacy Policy, including California Privacy Rights. By continuing to access or use our website, you agree to our Terms of Use including the arbitration and class action waiver.Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information / Opt OutAccept AllPrivacy Preferences ENABLE ACCESSIBILITY BOGO (Buy One, Get One) TERMS GENERAL TERMS Limited to one free regular-priced entree item with the purchase of another entrée item of equal or greater value. One free menu item max; redemption is subject to availability. Valid only until 12/31/22. Redeemable in-restaurant, or orders via Chipotle website[s] or mobile app, from participating US Chipotle locations; not valid on third party delivery platforms. Kids' meals do not count as an entrée purchase. [Purchased items are eligible for Chipotle Rewards points; the promotion may not otherwise be combined with other coupons, promotions, or special offers. Additional restrictions may apply; void where prohibited. HOCKEY BOGO Limit five free menu items per transaction; each free item requires purchase of an entrée item of equal or greater value and may be collected only by the jersey-wearing customer. Valid only on 6/30/22, after 4:00PM mountain time. Redeemable in-restaurant only, at participating Colorado Chipotle locations; not valid for catering, mobile, online or delivery orders. Kids’ meals do not count as an entrée purchase. Redemption is subject to availability. Purchased items are eligible for Chipotle Rewards points; the promotion may not otherwise be combined with other coupons, promotions or special offers. Additional restrictions may apply; void where prohibited.
